bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
cid=gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1
root=/home/gace/.local/share/gace-create-videobot/native-sticker-c8c50d420c0b9b5d447a1fc87ef3d9e1ec7aceed
stage="$root/.releases/8e35800be335a61d8910b066d2130a05a8dcf9a8/video-dualmode-three-way-stage"
mask=0
if test "$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{.State.Running}}' 2>/dev/null)" = true;then mask=$((mask+1));fi
if test "$(docker image inspect create-videobot:local-poll --format '{{.Id}}' 2>/dev/null)" = "$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{.Image}}' 2>/dev/null)";then mask=$((mask+2));fi
bit=4
for p in src/telegram/paidListingPublisher.mjs src/telegram/creatorWiring.mjs src/telegram/creatorBot.mjs src/runtime/creatorPollingMain.mjs;do
 if test -f "$stage/live/$p" && test "$(sha256sum "$stage/live/$p" | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$(docker exec "$cid" sha256sum "/opt/videobot/$p" 2>/dev/null | cut -d' ' -f1)";then mask=$((mask+bit));fi
 bit=$((bit*2))
done
if test -d "$stage/live";then mask=$((mask+64));fi
exit "$mask"
